citations.assessment: Glick’s Ein Yaakov has Difti and Abba. The other digital Ein Yaakov has Gifti with Rabbah parenthesized and Abba bracketed. These attest both variant names across witnesses; the exact form of Heilprin’s exemplar remains qualified.

evidence.witness: En Jacob, translated by SH Glick, 1916

citations.assessment: The Bavli explicitly reads Abba bar Shumnei opposite Menashya bar Yirmeyah of Gifti, in the farewell story at the crossing.
